summary: Kennedy Lewis Capital Company, a Delaware-incorporated business development company, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its net asset value (NAV) per share as of July 31, 2026, and the status of its ongoing continuous public offering. Class I, S, and D shares reported NAVs of $20.09, $20.05, and $20.09, respectively, with aggregate NAV of $754.5 million and portfolio fair value of $1.168 billion. The filing details shares sold in both its registered offering (up to $2.0 billion) and private placement under Section 4(a)(2), totaling approximately $672.1 million in consideration through the August 3, 2026 subscription date. This is routine periodic disclosure, not a special situation; the continuous offering proceeds on a monthly basis without tender, restructuring, or strategic elements.
